Identified Gap: No formally defined ISMS scope; boundaries of protected systems, clinics and data are undocumented
Recommended Control: A.5.1 Policies for Information Security (supported by a documented ISMS Scope Statement)

Identified Gap: Information security policies are incomplete, outdated or not formally approved by management
No formal information asset inventory; patient records, payroll and supplier data are not classified or tracked
Recommended Control: A.5.9 Inventory of Information Assets; A.5.12 Classification of Information

Identified Gap: Risk assessments are performed inconsistently and there is no formal risk register (decisions made case by case)
Recommended Control: A.5.9 (asset basis for risk) supported by a formal risk assessment methodology and risk register

Identified Gap: Security controls have not been formally selected or documented; no Statement of Applicability (SoA) exists
Recommended Control: Formal SoA referencing all 93 Annex A controls with inclusion/exclusion justification

Identified Gap: Security awareness training is not conducted regularly for clinical, IT and admin staff
Recommended Control: A.6.3 Information Security Awareness, Education and Training

Identified Gap: Supplier security requirements are not consistently evaluated before onboarding third parties
Recommended Control: A.5.19 Information Security in Supplier Relationships; A.5.20 Addressing Security Within Supplier Agreements
